Lit almost entirely in azure blue and deep royal blue, matching the reference palette. Pale ice-blue highlights only. STRICTLY NO cyan, NO teal, NO magenta, NO purple, NO green, NO orange, NO white background. Very dark blue-black environment, volumetric haze, shallow depth of field, cinematic photoreal 3D render. Absolutely no text, no lettering, no signage, no brand marks, no people.
